title: Field Solar Sales Consultant
description:
Job Title: Field Sales Consultant, Domestic Solar & Battery Storage

Salary: 40,000 basic plus 6% of turnover on every deal, uncapped, plus electric company car

Location: Eastbourne, covering Sussex

Imagine a diary full of homeowners who have already asked to speak to you. Nobody bought the lead. Nobody else is racing you to the front door. Every enquiry was generated by the business you work for, and it is yours alone.

That is what this role offers, and for an experienced solar or battery salesperson it is rare. You spend your time doing what you are good at: visiting a home, understanding what the customer wants to solve, and designing a system that does it.

Why this role

Most solar salespeople are tired of shared leads and thin pipelines. Here the enquiries come in warm and exclusive, from a business that generates its own demand and controls how much it brings in.

You would sell premium solar and battery systems to high-end homeowners. The customers are discerning and the jobs are substantial. It suits someone polished, organised and comfortable in a consultative conversation.

What you'll do

You will visit the customer, survey the property, create an initial design that is good enough to quote, and close the sale. You take the deposit, then hand the project to a dedicated project manager.

The approach is consultative. There is urgency, but delivered calmly. You present the right solution to the customer's problem and always book the next step before you leave. There is no "sign today" pressure. Hard closers will struggle here, unless they are genuinely exceptional.

You will be based in the Eastbourne office, in most days unless you are out on appointments, covering Sussex.

About the company

This is a small, founder-led business with a strong team culture and ambitious plans. It sells its own-brand battery technology, which means more capacity at a better price, and all support is in house. One company owns the whole job, so you have something confident to sell and nothing to apologise for after installation.

You will be trained by the founder, who walks you through the process over the first few weeks before you go out alone. You will report directly to them.

About you

You have field sales experience in domestic solar or battery storage, or a close home-improvement or energy background with a consultative style. You are presentable, punctual and do what you say you will. You follow up without being pushy, and you are motivated by earning well. You can get to Eastbourne most days.

Rewards & growth

The basic salary is 40,000. Commission is 6% of turnover on every deal, with no cap, and starts once your monthly sales cover your basic. On a 10,000 job, that is 600. There are realistic six-figure earnings for strong performers, and the basic can rise over time for consistent high performers.

You also get a brand new electric company car, which you can take home.

title: Sales and Account Executive
description:
Our client is a manufacturing company who specialise in the production of high precision machined components. A vacancy has arisen for a Sales and Account Executive to join their busy and hardworking team in St Leonards on Sea.

The ideal candidate will have demonstrable experience in a sales or account management role, have a proven track record of managing existing accounts and winning new business as well as experience using CRM systems and managing accurate sales records. You will possess excellent customer service skills, be able to read technical drawings and communicate requirements clearly and actively be able to identify solutions for customers and internal teams.

As a Sales and Account Executive you will be the primary commercial contact for existing customers as well as new business prospects, building strong relationships, understanding customers needs and working with internal teams to ensure strong levels of customer service and growth are achieved.

The Ideal candidate will possess the following skills and qualities:
- Demonstrable experience in a sales or account management role, ideally within manufacturing, precision engineering or similar
- Proven track record of managing existing accounts and winning new business
- Familiarity with B2 B customer interactions, ideally including OEMs and subcontract supplies/customers
- Experience using CRM systems and maintaining accurate sales records
- Ability to build trust and maintain long-term client relationships
- Understanding pricing, margins and business profitability
- Ability to read drawings, understand manufacturing processes and communicate technical requirements clearly
- Be able to present to customers, negotiate terms and close deals
- Possess strong organisational and time management
- Ability to proactively identify solutions for customers and internal teams
- Be competent in MS Office including teams

Your duties as a Sales and Account Executive will be:
- Serve as the main point of contact for existing customers, fostering strong relationships and high customer satisfaction
- Understand customer operations and manufacturing requirements to help them solve issues with the company s capabilities
- Coordinate internally with scheduling, production and quality teams to ensure timely fulfilment and service excellence
- Identify, research and engage potential new customers suitable for the company s capabilities
- Evaluate the business opportunities with new leads, prepare and present quotations and proposals to win new business
- Attend industry events, exhibitions and networking opportunities to represent the company and build the portfolio of customers
- Setting key targets with the site manager and reviewing on a monthly/quarterly and annual basis
- Working with site manager and production teams to convert enquiries into orders
- Maintaining/help developing accurate CRM records and track progress against sales targets
- Preparing sale reports, forecasts and insights for site manager to report to the board
- Providing exceptional customer service and communication
- Responding promptly to all technical and commercial enquiries
- Following up on quotes, manage negotiations and help close business
- Proactively identify opportunities for upselling additional services

Salary:

£30,000 - £40,000 per annum (plus commission/bonus)

Hours:

Monday Friday, 38 hour per week

Full Time, Permanent

St Leonards on Sea, East Sussex
